name: setup-band
description: Shows whether this computer's Claude setup is current and backed up: rules version vs GitHub, the weekly update, unpublished rule edits, projects not backed up and tool versions, with Update now, Ask Claude, What's new, Details and Projects buttons.

show.title: What the band shows
show.description: everything: always one line, with a check when all is well. problems only: nothing at all until something needs you.

checkMinutes.title: Check every (minutes)
checkMinutes.description: How often the band checks the rules, the weekly update and your projects. Plugin and tool versions are checked every 30 minutes.

notify.title: Pop-up for new problems
notify.description: Show a short pop-up the first time something needs you, so you notice even without looking at the band.
